title: Import a rikma
subtitleNew: This is a draft - nothing has been created yet. Fix what needs fixing, untick what is not for now, and create it all with one click.
subtitleExisting: Adding to the rikma "{{name}}". Nothing has been created yet - tick what to create and click once.

field.name: Rikma name
field.heading: The rikma itself
field.linkInvalid: An address starting with https:// or http://
field.pinned: There is also a point on the map - it is kept as it is.
field.restimeHint: How long a proposal stays open before silence counts as agreement.

holder.toggle: Click to switch between "I do this" and "Looking for someone" (looking = matching members get an email)

row.name: Name
row.partOf: Will be created as part of "{{name}}"
row.keywordsHint: Comma-separated - how a customer would describe the need, not the product's name. This is how the concierge finds you.
row.categoriesHint: Up to 3, comma-separated (e.g. events, food). Linked to the domains that already exist on the site; the concierge compares them with every wish.
row.descripPlaceholder: What needs doing, and how we know it is done
row.noValue: The value is worked out once there are hours and a rate

conflict: The draft changed meanwhile (maybe in the chat with your assistant) - this is the latest version. Check it and click again.
error: Creating did not work. Try again in a moment.

result.title: Created
result.proposals: The rows you did not tick were kept as proposals on the rikma's planning board.

invite.invited: {{name}} was invited - a card on their heart page and an email.
invite.notRegistered: {{name}} is not on 1lev1 yet. Send them the join link:
invite.pendingVote: {{name}} will be invited once the rikma approves the mission.
invite.noEmail: No email was given for {{name}}, so no invitation was sent.
invite.other: The invitation to {{name}} was not sent.

preview.title: Preview
preview.banner: Preview - nothing has been created yet. This is how the rikma will look on 1lev1.
preview.split: How the shares form - an example
preview.splitNote: By the value each side brings: hours × rate, and resources at their price. An illustration only - the real split is agreed together.
preview.ownerHint: The rikma has not been created yet. Whoever drafted it creates it with one click on the review screen.

share.ready: Here is the link - whoever gets it can see, not edit. It works for {{days}} days; a new link cancels the previous one.
share.error: We couldn't make a link. Try again.

receive.title: A rikma prepared for you
receive.expired: This link is no longer valid. Ask whoever prepared the rikma for a new one.
receive.taken: This rikma has already been handed over and is no longer waiting at this link.
receive.otherAccount: This rikma was prepared for {{email}}. To receive it, sign in to that address's account and open the link again.
receive.unverified: We could not check this link right now. Try again in a moment.

save.pending: {{count}} unsaved changes - they are also saved when you click "Create".
save.saved: Saved - your assistant sees the changes too.
save.partial: Some changes were not accepted. Check the rows and try again.
save.error: Saving failed. Try again in a moment.
